policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Chad advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Chad's visa through the competent mission before travel.
conditions: The current Austrian guidance identifies Chad's Embassy in Berlin; this excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Liberia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Liberia's visa through the competent mission before travel.
conditions: The current Austrian guidance identifies Liberia's Embassy in Berlin; this excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors must obtain the Republic of the Congo visa through the named Austrian or German consular channel before travel.
conditions: The current Austrian guidance identifies the honorary consulate in Vienna and embassy in Berlin; this excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Turkmenistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Turkmenistan's visa through its Vienna embassy before travel.
conditions: This excludes transit, non-visitor purposes, exceptional invitations and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Burkina Faso's electronically issued short-stay visa before travel.
conditions: Apply through the official online channel before travel; approved applicants receive the EVISA document by email.
This excludes work, residence, special documents and final admission.

application.label: Visa Burkina official eVisa service
steps: Present the approved EVISA document at entry.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire airport-issued visitor visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors using Côte d'Ivoire's online pre-registration receive the visa at Abidjan airport before passport control.
conditions: The current guidance requires prior registration and fee payment at least three days before travel, but identifies Abidjan airport as the issuance point.
This excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Iraq advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Iraq's visa at an Iraqi foreign mission before entry.
conditions: The exceptional direct-entry Kurdistan route is not the nationwide Iraq baseline.
This excludes security conditions, non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Comoros arrival visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Comoros' visa on arrival at the airport.
conditions: The Austrian guidance specifies payment in euros at airport arrival; this excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Jordan's single-entry visa on arrival at the airport.
conditions: Entry via the King Hussein Bridge from the West Bank requires a visa before entry and does not displace the airport arrival route.
This excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Djibouti electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Djibouti's eVisa before travel or use an overseas Djiboutian mission; airport visas are no longer issued.
conditions: Airport arrival issuance is expressly unavailable.
This excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Panama visitor exemption
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors are visa-free for Panama stays up to 90 days.
conditions: Applies to entry and stays up to 90 days; onward travel and funds can be checked at entry.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: Tunisia visitor exemption
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors are visa-free for Tunisia stays up to three months.
conditions: This excludes non-visitor purposes, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Austrian ordinary passports: British Virgin Islands visitor exemption
policies.summary: Austrian ordinary-passport visitors are visa-free for the British Virgin Islands, subject to the local immigration reporting and entry-fee requirements.
conditions: The guidance requires reporting to Immigration Services and payment of an entry fee, plus evidence of return travel and means.
This excludes work, residence, special documents and final admission.

conflicts.explanation: Current Austrian guidance requires online pre-registration but says the visa is issued at Abidjan airport before passport control; actual issuance timing is visa_on_arrival.
The current Austrian Embassy Iraq guidance says visas must be requested at an Iraqi foreign mission before entry; a geographically limited Kurdistan exception is not the national visitor baseline.
Current Austrian guidance states that Djibouti airport visas are no longer issued and identifies eVisa issuance before entry.

unresolved.reason: Sierra Leone's live service exposes Austrian eVisa products and says accepted eVisas are emailed, but the same current service also says visas are issued at the airport or border. Without independent current Austrian guidance resolving that issuance conflict, the pair remains unverified.
